title: Issue Tracker
summary: Canonical issue board for transcript-derived findings. Open items live in the append-only ledger; the page summarizes state and points at the schema.

sections.content: Tracker seeded from the Archive 3 review transcript. Open rows are actionable follow-ups; the resolved row records the cleanest completed fix so the backlog stays honest about what is already closed.

The ledger is append-only JSONL. It is meant for durable issue tracking inside the repo, not for ad hoc notes. Each entry uses a strict schema so downstream docs, search, and analytics can read it without heuristics.

sections.caption: Issue ledger entries validate against this schema.
Append-only JSONL issue ledger seeded from the transcript.

rows: Schema validator now checks schemas with the correct metaschema path
Switched schema self-validation to check_schema() and reran the validator successfully.
Strict schema validator still lacks regression tests
Add valid-schema, invalid-schema, and inventory-wide strict-mode coverage.
AgentLoop extraction still depends on façade backreferences
Finish the port-based extraction and remove the remaining façade coupling.
ModelRuntime snapshots session metadata at construction
Read live turn/session context instead of constructor-time copies.
Failed tool resolution can short-circuit into final assistant output
Split valid tool, failed tool, and final assistant continuations.
Governed context injection still lacks direct contract tests
Add a model-facing test for message order, receipt binding, and deduplication.
Tool result cache still falls back to ambient cwd and package-local storage
Pass explicit workspace identity and move cache storage out of the package tree.
Generated-code compiler still accepts unsafe arbitrary input forms
Constrain the IR, remove arbitrary templates, and inspect AST before import.
Static site renderer still has unsafe JSON-LD and disclosure seams
Fail closed on missing validator, harden structured data, and fix telemetry disclosure.
Telemetry mode vocabulary still splits across runtime, profile, and projection
Define one enum and make all projection and runtime layers use it.
Steward leaves partial claims behind on failure paths
Rollback claims on downstream failure and separate preview events from dispatch.
ConversationRuntime parity test still protects the old architecture
Rewrite or delete the parity test so it matches the current production flow.
